tools.name: find_local_businesses
tools.description: Start here. Find businesses that fit a need near a place. Give the service in a few plain words ("furnace repair", "water heater leak"), not the user's sentence; timing goes in open_at. Each result says why it fits, its hours and whether it is open right now (by its stated hours at its local time; "

tools.name: more_results
tools.description: The next page of a search, with the next_cursor the search returned; kept 24 hours. Narrowing the need usually beats paging.

tools.name: get_business_record
tools.description: One business's full record by website domain: prices, offers, hours, every way to act, each fact with its source and date, and every source's value where they disagree. Open it for a finalist, and whenever a phone or address matters. A business that is not listed cannot be opened.

tools.name: check_places_results
tools.description: Check up to 10 businesses you found elsewhere (maps, web, a link) before you give your user a phone or send them somewhere: open or closed with dated evidence, the phone its sources agree on, how to act. Send the name plus phone, website or address, and the town. With the need, you also get two list

tools.name: get_field_history
tools.description: Every value one fact (phone, hours, address, name) has held, which source said it and when. Use it when a value matters and you want to judge how settled it is.

tools.name: report_answer
tools.description: When a business told you something its record lacks ("yes, certified kosher"), record the question and its answer in its words, with the business's truvon_id.

tools.name: report_outcome
tools.description: After you have acted for your user (booked, ordered, called, got a quote): say what happened, with the search_id and the business's truvon_id. If something was arranged you get the questions to ask your user later and, for a job, a job id. Test traffic (x-truvon-test) is refused: dry-run at https://

tools.name: report_missing
tools.description: A business that fits your user's need, that you found elsewhere (the web, a map), and Truvon does not list (check_places_results said so): send its name, its own website, phone, address and the town, with the need and the search_id. It is read and listed for every agent; the directory grows where ag

tools.name: answer_follow_up
tools.description: Days later, when the outcome is knowable: send your user's answers to the questions report_outcome gave you, by follow_up id. Closed options only, never personal details.

tools.name: get_job
tools.description: When your user returns asking about a job you arranged: its status and the business's updates, by the job id report_outcome gave you.

tools.name: connect_truvon
tools.description: When your app has not signed in to Truvon itself: get a link for your user to open and a connection code for you. One tap on the link (no account) and the reporting tools accept connection in this conversation. Searching needs none of this.
